differential.name: End-stage renal disease due to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stage 4) with proteinuria, microalbuminuria, high creatinine, and awaiting transplant in a diabetic patient.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Long‑standing hypertension and CKD progression; common cause of renal insufficiency in older adults.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD stage 4–5, likely from reduced erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Obstructive sleep apnea
differential.rationale: Obesity (BMI >30) and diagnosed sleep apnea, contributing to hypertension and cardiovascular risk.

differential.name: Hyperlipidemia (elevated LDL)
differential.rationale: Dyslipidemia with LDL 125 mg/dL and total cholesterol 198 mg/dL, a risk factor for atherosclerotic disease in this patient.
